invariants.rule: A species may define no progression or maturation unlock hooks; absence is valid and must not synthesize a progression tree.

Every permanent or conditional species-origin advancement acquisition/unlock is committed as an attributable canonical Character/Progression Event with before/result state and source evidence; silent Character mutation is forbidden.
Lifecycle descriptors and chronological age are non-executable; mechanical maturation requires an explicit source-backed rule and progression/Event handoff.
Eligibility, prerequisites, acquisition modes, costs, waivers, grants and reference value remain with CAB/Progression and other owning domains; MVPS-10 stores typed references/handoffs only.
Duplicate, stacking, suppression, replacement and magnitude semantics defer to the owning shared mechanic/rules profile and are never resolved by species-local logic.

Maturation and progression events preserve base species selection/history, exact source/version references and provenance; correction uses a new attributable event or owner-defined compensation rather than history rewrite.
MVPS-10 does not create a progression, XP/cost, prerequisite, Ability, Action/Event, Effect, Condition, Resource or grant-execution engine.
Form/transformation semantics remain MVPS-09, social/language/knowledge hooks remain MVPS-11, and active runtime contribution/grant projection remains MVPS-13.
